ac:layout-cell.h1: Invoice Sending Sequence and Reuse Assessment
ac:layout-cell.p: Solution Summary · Logical Feature Specification · API Reference · Feature landing page

This separate engineering view extends SPEC-SEI-007 with the supplied FR sending guide and preserved Send e-invoice OpenAPI snapshot. This revision records the six-case Spain route rule, the onboarding handoff under SND-G09, private-platform SPFE copy ownership and its unresolved result/retry gap, and the proposed withdrawal interaction under SND-G04/G05/G07. It assesses proposed Spain extensions without treating the France contract as Spain implementation evidence. The predecessor stays unchanged, including OUT-INT-01–11, OUT-D01–12 and detailed field traceability.

Existing OUT IDs retain their meanings. The current journey is per invoice; bulk accountant sending remains separate unqualified scope. The PDF assessment implements the recorded product direction in PRD-SEI-246. SND-G IDs identify engineering gaps. API qualification checks in §5 link to existing functional acceptance. Publication selects SPEC-SEI-022 for the existing summary page, with this assessment and SPEC-SEI-023 as companions. All three remain drafts; publication does not approve new APIs.

Assess the existing FR sending APIs before proposing another submission interface. Reuse is a candidate pending the selected build, contracts and Spain qualification. SPEC-SEI-023 owns behaviour. The FR guide starts with ready files and a connected dataset; it does not establish the full Spain draft-to-issuance journey. INT-SND01; REF-BASE/PRODUCT.
No breaking API change has been established. The rows below identify integration work and evidence to assess, rather than approved endpoint development.

tr.th: Possible shared API or country/provider work

tr.td: Customer platform discovery
Reuse onboarding connection reads for OUT-00; see §2.0.
ERP can show customer platforms before sender selection. Qualify separate sending and receiving availability; discovery does not activate a route. INT-AP07; SND-G09.
Draft preparation and final handoff
Qualify complete-data intake, final identity/revision binding, approval and ERP issuance coordination. No physical methods/paths are evidenced.
A current file-upload integration may need additional preparation and issuance handoffs. Exact contract is open. SND-G01/06.
Spain public recipient delivery / required copy
Bind public UBL profile, authority, original/copy purpose, transport and request/item results. Determine whether the existing API exposes these distinctions.
Retain separate delivery/copy results and actual issuance evidence. One generic submission/status cannot be assumed sufficient. SND-G02/05/06.
Spain private platforms
Qualify provider access-point/address rules, format, trust and action outcome meanings.
Reuse create/upload/detail only for a supported Spain provider. Confirm which file is required and how failures return. SND-G02/03/05.
Shared events, reads and recovery
Qualify key/replay semantics, lost-ID discovery, upload completion, event security and authoritative results.
Retain original IDs and input; handle partial uploads, failed processing, duplicate/out-of-order events and missing notifications. SND-G04/05/07.
Transformation and derived files
Assess existing DTS for the selected Spain mapping. Factur-X generation is a separate documented FR retrieval option.
Do not require another ERP to produce a finished file merely because the FR guide starts there. Qualify file-generation ownership and mapping. SND-G01/03.
Transitional PDF companion
The local product generates the PDF. Assess existing attachment transport for qualified private delivery and a separate recipient channel where needed.
Implement OUT-PDF-R01/02; exclude this PDF from public requests. Do not infer Spain delivery or server-side generation from application/pdf support. SND-G08; RD238-T2.

ac:layout-cell.p: An authorised accountant sends one invoice for one client through the same POST/upload/result flow as the business user. The guide documents one recipient per submission; it supplies no bulk coordinator contract. Public transport batches in the AEAT catalogue are a different concern. INT-SND01; SND-G06.
The SPEC-SEI-022 combined overview shows the entry choices defined by SPEC-SEI-023 entry actions. They select these interaction paths:

tr.td: Use the connection, submission, action-result and recovery interactions in §§2.0–2.3 for the current invoice.

SPEC-SEI-015 IC-12 prepares the separate rectifying invoice. Its sending handoff uses §§2.0–2.3 with the new identity and original reference; ERP issuance and required-copy coordination remain under OUT-Q03.

Use §2.4 with the saved earlier submission, original/copy purpose and destination. New-send platform selection cannot retarget cancellation. Recheck current authority and eligibility; unresolved target or result evidence holds that cancellation attempt.

ac:layout-cell.p: The diagrams use grey — Existing for documented calls and blue — Proposed for Spain handoffs. Red — Open, Assumption, Gap or Source conflict marks unresolved evidence or contracts. Read the text label beside each colour. Participants group responsibilities, not approved deployments. Requests use solid arrows; paired responses use dashed arrows. Grey bars show handling, not elapsed time. Colour does not establish Spain implementation support.

This read step supports SPEC-SEI-023 OUT-00. It reuses onboarding operations before sending; it does not create a new Sending endpoint. The ERP uses the represented customer's authorised dataset and environment. INT-AP07.

At final planning, OUT-10 checks the exact selected sender access point against these connections and current sending readiness. OUT-A23 covers a sender with SPFE and ZeroComa available, then rejects ZeroComa selection when its connection is missing. This check does not verify the recipient. Private delivery follows the selected provider's qualified contract without a mandatory Sage recipient lookup; qualify any public-recipient check separately under OUT-09. No recipient-directory API is established by the reviewed SPFE bundle. SND-G02/09; SPEC-SEI-023 REF-LOOKUP.

The ERP's proposed per-invoice identities and platform selections are mapped in SPEC-SEI-043 §1.2. Sender selection is explicit. An omitted recipient platform requires qualified resolution before dispatch; otherwise the ERP must supply it. These request changes retain the existing create/upload/observe sequence.

tr.td: 1. GET /datasets/{datasetId}/accesspoints

Returns 200 with data[]: access-point id, attributes.name, attributes.status (CONNECTED or DISCONNECTED) and nullable attributes.connectionId. Keep access-point and connection IDs distinct. This is the customer's connection list; the general access-point catalogue alone does not establish a customer connection. See SPEC-SEI-040 API-02.
2. GET /connectors/{accessPointId}/datasets/{datasetId}/connections/{connectionId}/

For a returned connection ID, read accessPointAddresses[], including status, errorCode, effectiveDate, endDate and usage. These address-level facts inform availability for each direction; they are not a complete readiness decision. See SPEC-SEI-040 API-04.

ac:layout-cell.p: Existing contract limit: the detail snapshot defines usage: ["SEND"] and ["EREPORTING"]. It says null or omitted usage permits send, receive and e-reporting; there is no RECEIVE enum value. Preserve this documented France meaning. Neither the list's CONNECTED value nor unrestricted usage proves country/provider readiness. Do not invent a direction field in either response. INT-AP07.

Spain qualification — SND-G09: Onboarding, API and Integration owners must confirm the selected build, dataset/platform mapping, direction rules, address validity and current readiness evidence before the ERP labels a platform available for sending or receiving. Public-platform discovery remains subject to onboarding's “SPFE use TBD” gate; no public enrolment API is established. Where the reads cannot establish availability, retain an unknown result and identify the missing evidence. Discovery supplies candidates; each offered connection still needs the readiness and destination-path checks in SPEC-SEI-043 §1.1.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 2.1 Documented current E-Invoice API submission and observation
ac:layout-cell.p: Editable Draw.io · PNG.

Use only after current business/action authority, a qualified CONNECTED setup and an approved file manifest. §2.0 supplies the connection-discovery handoff. 201 creates the Sage resource and upload references. PUT success confirms upload under its contract. The event can report processing success or ERROR; read details to establish the actual result. None of these facts alone proves buyer acceptance. INT-SND01 prerequisites and steps 1–5; OUT-A10/13/14.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 2.2 Spain final plan and independent actions
ac:layout-cell.p: Editable Draw.io · PNG.

The public and private recipient routes are alternatives. The private-platform lane performs the proposed Phase 2 copy action; Sage performs that role when it operates as the private platform. Red labels keep the assumed copy capability and missing report/acknowledgement contract visible. The copy/issuance frame shows logical coordination, not physical timing or an atomic transaction. OUT-Q03 must prove the boundary and failure handling; SND-G05 owns the result-reporting and retry gaps. Public protocol execution follows SPEC-SEI-011; destination evidence follows SPEC-SEI-012 and connection context follows SPEC-SEI-014. SPFE-S02/S08/S16; OUT-A03/04/07/12; OUT-SPFE-A01.

The diagram covers private delivery with a required copy and direct public recipient delivery. It does not show every sender-to-recipient platform combination. The table below makes the API coverage and remaining gaps explicit. Public/private describes the platform used by each party. The copy decision also needs evidence of the platform actually used for issuance or interconnection; a private recipient alone does not establish a copy obligation. OUT-09/10; OUT-SPFE-R01; SPFE-S02 Articles 3.4/4.

tr.td: Public → private

Open: Public issuance/interconnection is recognised in the source rules, but the public-to-private transfer is not shown in this sequence. Qualify how the private platform obtains the invoice, who performs the transfer, authority, correlation and recipient-delivery evidence. No public forwarding endpoint or private-provider download contract is established by the FR POST/upload guide. SND-G02/05/06.
Existing: None for an invoice already issued or interconnected through the public platform. Do not submit it again as a copy.
Private → private

Proposed: The FR create/upload/event/detail flow is a candidate product-facing interface. Private delivery in the diagram covers the logical action. Qualify delivery within one provider and interconnection between different providers separately, including their downstream APIs and outcome meanings. The guide does not prove either Spain provider contract. SND-G02/03/05.

Proposed: In Phase 2, the selected private platform sends the faithful SPFE copy using its own capability; Sage observes the copy result it reports. When Sage operates as a private platform, Sage sends the copy. The external platform's capability is an Assumption, expected but not confirmed; PPIFE_competitor_analysis.xlsx is user-supplied and not preserved here. Copy-result/error reporting to Sage and failed-copy retry ownership are Gaps under SND-G05. Keep delivery and copy results separate.
Private → public

Proposed: The public action uses qualified SendInvoice interconnection with an original, rather than a faithful-copy submission standing in for delivery. The WSDL establishes public intake; the selected private-provider-to-public handoff and recipient availability/delivery evidence remain to qualify. SND-G02/05/06.
Existing: No additional copy once public interconnection is established for that invoice. An earlier copy needs the governed transition in OUT-SPFE-R02; it is not a fresh-send shortcut.
Public → public

Existing: Public issuance or interconnection supplies the public original. The FR POST/upload flow does not document the AEAT invoice-generation form. Qualify the applicable public submission or retrieval path and recipient outcome; do not create the already-issued invoice again. SND-G02/05/06.
Existing: None for the established public issuance/interconnection.

ac:layout-cell.p: All four combinations remain subject to selected-build and end-to-end contract qualification. Follow the six-case public-route decision in SPEC-SEI-023 OUT-09; PRIVATE_READY and PROVEN_NONE keep their existing meanings. Public admission, product upload and notification arrival are distinct evidence levels. An unknown transfer/result holds the affected action under §2.3; it cannot trigger a second delivery route or a new copy. The applicable transitional PDF uses §3.3 independently of this table. OUT-A03–05/07/08; OUT-SPFE-A01/02; INT-SND01; SPFE-S02 Articles 3–5; SPFE-S16.

This sequence expands an E recovery case from the SPEC-SEI-022 sending overview: a missing or uncertain external result. SPEC-SEI-023 — Exceptions, errors and recovery also covers blocked inputs, readiness and other failure conditions.
Editable Draw.io · PNG.

Use the known e-invoice ID to query details. A lost POST response may leave no ID; the guide supplies no discovery-by-key contract. An empty/failed query is not proven absence. Keep the original context and owner until the selected contract supports a safe next action. Do not resend successful recipient delivery because a copy or status query is unknown. OUT-13; SND-G04; OUT-A07/08/16.

blockquote.p: PROPOSED (Solution Design: Samu Coco / Jiaxin He, 18 Nov 2026) - Proposed responsibility and eligibility extension: Sending owns cancellation request, response and recovery. Cancellation carries no invoice UBL; it is a status-update (cancellation) message. Apply both state and reason conditions in SPEC-SEI-023 proposed eligibility. After technical rejection, resend with the same number only for sending/routing or format/UBL representation fixes. Errors in issued amounts, NIF or tax require a rectifying invoice; do not edit fiscal content. Cancel and rectify remain independent. This block marks the proposed replacements in the interaction table below; struck text remains for comparison. SD-CANCEL01 C-1/C-2/C-4/P-1/P-2.

ac:layout-cell.p: SPEC-SEI-023 OUT-SPFE-R02 owns eligibility, case classification and preservation of invoice instances. The proposed direction is a distinct issuer action on the existing e-invoice resource, subject to Architecture decision and design. The interaction below is Product analysis and a logical proposal; it selects no send flag, endpoint, field or wire-status value. Lifecycle owns the resulting cancelled product state. FP-SEI-002 records the open contract and Compliance questions.

tr.th: Interaction and recovery evidence to qualify

tr.td: Request and identify

~~The product requests withdrawal for the existing resource. Resolve the exact earlier submission, original/copy purpose, represented business, environment and original destination. The reusable SPFE business identifier alone cannot distinguish successive instances. Hold an ambiguous target.~~ Replacement proposal: The ERP requests cancellation of the exact earlier invoice and original/copy action for its represented business, environment and destination. Preserve its fiscal number and historical association; a catalogue identifier capability does not authorise another invoice to take that number. SD-CANCEL01 C-2/P-1.
Validate and record

Check current issuer/delegate authority and OUT-SPFE-R02 eligibility. Retain the request and its separate attempt/result before external execution. Qualify request identity, input binding, repeat/concurrency handling and target stability. Existing send idempotency does not prove withdrawal safety.
SND-G04.
Execute

~~Bind a permitted public withdrawal to the reviewed CancelInvoice contract through SPEC-SEI-011. Qualify protection against concurrent identifier reuse and delayed/repeated cancellation. Hold execution or reuse when that protection cannot be established. Private-provider execution remains unqualified.~~ Replacement proposal: Sending sends an eligible status-update (cancellation) message with no invoice UBL. Verify both the state and nonexistent-operation reason under SPEC-SEI-023. Retain the separate public cancellation business-document qualification and protect the exact target against repeated, delayed and concurrent requests. Private-provider support remains unqualified. SD-CANCEL01; SPFE-S02 Articles 3.5/5.5; SPFE-S10.
SND-G04/07; SPFE-S10.
Observe

~~Correlate the external response, saved result, read and any notification to the original withdrawal attempt and submission instance. Request acceptance is not external success. Preserve unrelated delivery/copy results; a late result must not update the new instance.~~ Replacement proposal: Sending receives and correlates the response before updating the initial cancellation status from its evidenced outcome. Lifecycle owns the resulting cancelled state. Distinguish request receipt, confirmed cancellation, failure and unknown outcome; preserve unrelated delivery/copy results. SD-CANCEL01 C-5/P-1.
SND-G05.
Recover

~~After a possible external effect, reconcile the original attempt. Do not repeat withdrawal or submit a new invoice to resolve uncertainty. Without qualified observation and safe replay, retain an unresolved result and an Operations owner. Release identifier reuse only after confirmed cancellation and qualified protection against stale attempts.~~ Replacement proposal: Sending reconciles the original attempt after a possible effect. Preserve an owned unresolved result until evidence resolves it; do not create a new invoice to resolve uncertainty. Confirmed cancellation: AEAT retains as cancelled the document SPFE holds for that invoice: the original when the original passed through SPFE (direct submission, or a private platform submitting the original through SPFE), or the faithful copy when the original was exchanged only through private platforms. The fiscal number remains consumed permanently. No rectification or reactivation is permitted. SD-CANCEL01 C-2/P-1.

ac:layout-cell.p: Reuse authority checks, operation history, notifications and reconciliation only after build qualification. Assess existing DTS first for the ApplicationResponse mapping; its invoice transformation support does not establish withdrawal support. Spain eligibility and transport bindings remain country-specific. SND-G03/07; REF-PRODUCT. The Article 5.5 copy-to-original transition needs its own qualified procedure; this interaction does not authorise it.
ac:layout-cell.h2: 3 Existing operations and material contract gaps
ac:layout-cell.p: SPEC-SEI-047 service mapping owns the cross-service SOAP-to-Sage API mapping. The table below assesses sending-specific reuse and engineering gaps.

The preserved OpenAPI snapshot is the schema baseline for the France-oriented operations below (OpenAPI 3.1.0, info version 1.0.0). INT-SND01 is separate supplied guide evidence and contains points of conflict with that snapshot. Neither source establishes the deployed build or Spain capability. Preserve exact fields and values, label each source, and resolve conflicts before generating a client. INT-SND01/02.

tr.th: Spain reuse assessment and functional coverage

tr.td: POST /internal/events/subscriptions; step 1 and overview
Existing: register resource einvoice, dataset, source and e-invoicing.einvoice.statusupdated. Operation card omits the leading slash. Success code/body not supplied.
Proposed reuse: notification pattern for OUT-14/15. Pin accessible API base, casing/schema, authentication, event library and Spain support. SND-G05/07.
POST /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices; OpenAPI operation and step 2

Existing: OpenAPI PostSendInvoiceRequest / PostSendInvoiceResponse; 201 Created; resource ID and attachment uploadUrl values. The snapshot requires Idempotency-Key and Authorization; traceparent and tracestate have required: false. INT-SND01 says all four headers are required.

Proposed reuse: prepared-file intake, not OUT-01–08 preparation or ERP issuance. Source conflict: tracing-header requirement differs; confirm selected contract. Confirm schema issues in SPEC-SEI-043 and qualify revision/action binding, key scope and asynchronous outcome. SND-G01/04/06/07; INT-SND01/02.
PUT {uploadUrl}; step 3
Existing: binary upload, one request per attachment; 200 OK; URL returned dynamically.

Proposed reuse: candidate file transport for OUT-11/12. Confirm required manifest, scan/completion trigger, expiry/renewal and partial/lost-upload recovery. Do not infer readiness from one uploaded file. SND-G03/04.
Status-updated webhook; step 4
Existing: environment/access-point-specific source and event type prefix; subject is the e-invoice ID. Example contains datasetid, event id and nullable data.errorCode.

Proposed reuse: observation for OUT-13–15; not a dispatch command or success-only event. Verify authenticity and scope, deduplicate, then read the authoritative result. Open: delivery/order/freshness semantics. SND-G05.
GET /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices/{e-invoiceId}; step 5
Existing: 200 OK; status/history, files and downloadUrl. operationStatus: IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ERROR.

Proposed reuse: observation using a retained ID. Open: exact meaning of each source status and relation to delivery/copy need qualification. The overview's collection path is not evidence of a search-by-idempotency operation. SND-G04/05/07.
Same GET with format=facturx; step 5
Existing: can generate and persist a Factur-X/ZUGFeRD 2.3 hybrid; returns an existing hybrid without regeneration.

Proposed reuse: optional FR representation capability. Exclude from routine status observation. Open: qualify Spain need, source preservation, mapping, concurrency and access before enabling. SND-G03.
SPFE service 01 — SendInvoice
SPEC-SEI-047 service mapping owns the operation mapping; SPEC-SEI-011 source contract binding owns exact transport and ports.
Qualify the sender-to-recipient paths and independent delivery/copy handoffs in §2.2 against the selected integration. SND-G02/05/06.

ac:layout-cell.p: Detailed API identity, routing and representation fields moved to SPEC-SEI-043.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.2 Shared authentication, safety and source conflicts
ac:layout-cell.p: Authenticate each caller, then check current represented-business and action authority. M2M access, a ready connection or trace IDs do not replace delegation or signing permission. Bind retained invoice, action and upload references to the correct business/environment. Keep token-bearing URLs and webhook credentials out of logs/events. These are proposed Sage controls supporting OUT-R07–14, not additional claims about the guide.

The guide documents Idempotency-Key for invoice POST but no key lifetime, input-binding rule or concurrency guarantee. The logical same-input replay/changed-input conflict requirement remains open at the API boundary. An upload retry and a fresh invoice POST have different effects. Qualify which party retries processing, the upload-complete trigger and how to observe the original action before repetition. SND-G04.

INT-SND01 records unresolved schema differences: subscription casing, data.id versus attributes.eInvoiceId, currentStatus object/string/empty object, a duplicated specversion, and unprefixed subscription event versus prefixed notification type. Its New example after the supposed sent event does not establish status progression. Obtain the actual schema/event/status contracts; do not build a normative payload from those examples. SND-G05/07.
Use SEI023's exception decisions for functional handling. The source values below identify evidence to inspect; they are not a complete error catalogue or universal retry policy. INT-SND01.

tr.td: SENDER_NOT_ONBOARDED; connection not CONNECTED
Guide prerequisite failure. Resolve selected setup and inspect the existing attempt before another submission. Do not infer that asynchronous POST acceptance proved readiness. SND-G02/04/06.

Identify the affected file and processing outcome. The guide's fresh-local-file advice establishes no amendment, deletion or upload-renewal endpoint. Qualify safe file recovery without changing issued content or creating another invoice. SND-G03/04.
Status event with data.errorCode; operationStatus: ERROR

Inspect the actual error and history for the original invoice/action. Processing completion can be an error; it cannot establish that every external action failed or can be repeated. Missing status/error-library semantics remain SND-G05.
Submitted, absent event or failed detail read

Non-production Submitted may indicate unresolved recipient registration. Use the retained ID for qualified observation; no notification or failed refresh establishes delivery or absence. A lost POST ID has no evidenced discovery-by-key operation. SND-G04/05.

ac:layout-cell.p: The selected contracts must establish error stage, effect certainty, retry ownership and observation evidence. HTTP error names alone cannot release a resend. No general-purpose cancellation endpoint or fixed retry/backoff schedule is evidenced by this guide.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.3 Transitional PDF generation and attachment delivery
ac:layout-cell.p: OUT-PDF-R01/02 owns behaviour. The local-product generation decision and legal applicability are recorded in PRD-SEI-246. The API carries supplied files; its attachment fields are not evidence that it generates the required PDF. REF-PDF-DECISION; RD238-T2.

tr.td: Local product generates the PDF
Bind the file to the exact invoice/revision and applicability result. This is the recorded product allocation, not an inferred FR API capability.
Declare a PDF for qualified private recipient delivery

Existing POST /datasets/{datasetId}/e-invoices uses attachments[].filename and attachments[].mimetype: "application/pdf". Include a matching product-generated file only when the selected Spain provider/connector is qualified to deliver it to the recipient. No new endpoint or Spain support is established by this field. INT-SND01 step 2.
Upload the binary

PUT the local product's file to its returned uploadUrl. Qualify binding, completion trigger, scanning, limits and retry safety. 200 OK proves the documented upload result only. INT-SND01 step 3; SND-G03/04.
Keep the public action separate

Do not forward this PDF to SendInvoice, inside UBL or as a separate MIME part. An existing common attachment list needs per-action destination filtering before reuse. Public request packaging of structured UBL is a different transport concern. RD238-T2; SND-G02/08.
Public structured route or private connector cannot deliver the PDF

Use a separately qualified recipient channel. Channel selection, operational owner, dispatch contract, timing and receipt evidence remain open; no email or other API is assumed. A private-upload capability cannot close this gap for the public route. SND-G08.
Confirm the recipient obligation

Correlate PDF delivery evidence or an owned pending/failure result to the invoice. Check whether the status/detail contract actually proves PDF delivery; do not infer it from general invoice processing completion. Recover only affected work. SND-G05/08.

ac:layout-cell.p: format=facturx remains a separate FR capability that can generate a hybrid on retrieval. It is not the decided generation path for this transitional PDF. A France-optional or Demo-required PDF setting does not determine Spain applicability. INT-SND01; OUT-PDF-R01.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.4 FR attempt errors and Annex II handoff
ac:layout-cell.p: The later INT-ERR01 error guide supplies error codes and clarifies the retrieve response. Read data.attributes.history[].operationStatus and history[].errorCode for the relevant attempt. currentStatus contains neither field; Submitted can coexist with a failed sending history item. The guide marks data.meta required. Pin the actual schema and attempt correlation before client generation; the development reference path containing 1.13.0 is not a deployment guarantee.

tr.td: Status notification follows handling; ERROR is final for that attempt

Record the terminal attempt and the associated invoice/action. Do not infer recipient success from notification arrival or use another history item's outcome. The relationship between a final failed attempt and later platform retry remains SND-G04/05.
ERR-SENDING-DOC-001–004

Source assigns retry to the platform flow and support if unchanged after six days. Product observes original work; it does not create another invoice, change key or repeat delivery/public copy. Prove platform retry trigger, identity, scope and evidence.
ERR-SENDING-DOC-005/006/007

Tracking persistence/unexpected errors require support; key lookup failure requires checking the original valid key and support if persistent. Preserve a possible provider effect even when local tracking failed. A new key is not a repair instruction.

Status-change processing is separate from invoice dispatch. Exact code actions are in INT-ERR01: selected temporary cases use platform retry; mapping/persistence/unsupported status cases need support or correction. Preserve irregular -0010/-0011. No whole-invoice resend to repair a status attempt.
Six-day support wording

Apply only to source rows that state it, after qualifying the selected FR build/runbook. It is not a general retry budget, Spain SLA, permission to delay a time-sensitive duty or the Articles 5.7/8.4 outage allowance.

ac:layout-cell.p: SPFE-S22 is a separate Annex II supplied on 22 October, not a new invoice-send error dictionary. Its reviewed event codes and key cardinalities align with final BOE Annex II. Recipient PAYMENT/REJECTION, issuer SETTLEMENT/DEFAULT and their cancellations belong to SPEC-SEI-009. A failed technical attempt cannot create a buyer rejection or cancel an invoice/report automatically. Keep FR processing codes, AEAT admission/error results and business lifecycle codes separate. SPFE-S02 Annex II; supplement comparison and remaining gates.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.5 Proposed Spain extension of the Send e-invoice API
ac:layout-cell.p: Detailed API fields, field-level reuse assessment, request and response examples, and confirmed contract defects moved to SPEC-SEI-043.

Each owner must record the source capability/build, retained behaviour, Spain changes, missing coverage and acceptance evidence before the affected scope is enabled. Existing implementation reuse and design-pattern reuse remain separate claims.

tr.td: SND-G01 Preparation and final intake
Actual complete-data and final-revision contracts, generation ownership and relationship to file POST. No claim that the supplied sending API covers preparation.
ERP Product, API, E-Invoice, Architecture.
SND-G02 Spain binding

Qualify reuse of the existing address pairs, the proposed Spain address-type value and recipient-platform field in SPEC-SEI-043 §1.2, NIF/routing-address mapping, explicit sender selection, recipient-platform identifiers and conditional resolution. Qualify recipient eligibility and the four platform combinations in §2.2. Apply the six-case public-route decision in SPEC-SEI-023 OUT-09. Qualify public/private handoffs, provider/environment IDs and route evidence. Preserve unresolved recipient scope and multiple-entry precedence. Pin public schemas, profile, size, batch, authority, locator and CSV meanings. Preserve SPFE-Q03/08/13/15/18.
Spain Compliance, Integration, Routing, API/public connector.
SND-G03 Files, DTS and trust
Required files, Spain UBL/profile and MIME support, scan/upload contracts, DTS build/mappings/rules, protected trust model and optional hybrid generation.
DTS, Validation, Trust, Security, Integration.
SND-G04 Mutation and recovery

~~Idempotency scope/window/input binding, concurrency, upload completion/renewal, lost-POST-ID discovery, original-action query and safe retry ownership. Qualify §2.4's withdrawal target binding, duplicate requests, lost responses and protection against stale cancellation after identifier reuse. Unproven absence cannot release resend. No withdrawal endpoint or equivalent Sage capability is established by the preserved contracts.~~ PROPOSED (Solution Design: Samu Coco / Jiaxin He, 18 Nov 2026) - Replacement: Retain sending replay/concurrency and lost-result recovery qualification. For cancellation, prove both state and reason checks, exact targeting, duplicate/late-response safety, retained cancelled history and permanent fiscal-number consumption. After technical rejection, distinguish same-number sending/routing/representation recovery from fiscal-content errors requiring a rectifying invoice. No cancellation interface implementation is established by the preserved Sage contracts. SD-CANCEL01 C-2/C-4/P-1/P-2.
API, Integration, Operations, Spain Compliance.
SND-G05 Events and result meanings

Subscription surface/schema, webhook security, selected source/type/status library, delivery/order/freshness, action-specific error outcomes and the additive per-action result representation. Reuse currentStatus, history[] and statusAttributes where they preserve their existing meaning. Qualify independent withdrawal results and exact-attempt/instance correlation under §2.4. Gap: define how a Phase 2 private platform reports its SPFE-copy result/errors to Sage and who retries a failed copy.
API, Events, private-platform Integration, Operations, Security.
SND-G06 Business coordination

Exact-revision decisions, current client authority and ERP issue/copy proof. OUT-Q02 portfolio/accounting contracts remain separate optional scope; no bulk API is required for the single-invoice flow.
Product, ERP, Identity, Compliance, Architecture.
SND-G07 Build and compatibility

Pin OpenAPI/event/schema versions, resolve snapshot/guide conflicts, correct confirmed contract defects, preserve France behaviour, and prove country isolation, monitoring/support, retention and measured capacity. Qualify §2.4 against the selected API, connector and DTS builds; unsupported countries/providers cannot inherit Spain withdrawal support. Qualify retry budgets, stalled-work detection, escalation and evidence-backed case closure; no numerical targets are established here.

Same-input POST replay, conflicting input, concurrent calls, cancellation races and lost response retain the original action. No second invoice when the ID is unknown; cancellation remains pending after a possible effect until qualified evidence resolves it. INT-SND01 step 2; SND-G04.

Partial, expired, rejected and uncertain uploads follow the pinned contract. Preserve good file bindings; no fresh invoice merely to renew upload access. Final bytes remain bound to the issued revision; scan failure cannot silently replace issued content. INT-SND01 step 3; SND-G03/04.
Notifications and results

Test success and ERROR notifications, duplicates, out-of-order or contradictory delivery, invalid scope or signature, lost events and failed refresh. Detail reads retain source evidence and freshness. Never infer buyer acceptance, copy completion or a need to resend. INT-SND01 steps 1, 4 and 5; SND-G05; OUT-A07, OUT-A08, OUT-A10 and OUT-A22.
Per-invoice identities and platform selection / OUT-A23

Qualify SPEC-SEI-043 §1.2 against the selected build. Test missing/null sender selection, NIF/connection mismatch, valid and disconnected/ineligible selections, and distinct sender/recipient platforms. Test supplied recipient destination without lookup, omitted platform with/without qualified resolution, ambiguous results and conflicts. Retain resolved evidence on unchanged replay; changed identities/platforms must conflict under the qualified input binding. No automatic SPFE fallback or fan-out. Isolate Spain address values, recipient-platform requiredness and validation from France. INT-SND02; INT-AP07; SND-G02/04/07.

For a sender with ready, permitted SPFE, ZeroComa and B2Brouter connections, select each on separate invoices without setup changes. Cover consecutive private-platform choices and reject an unconnected or ineligible selection. Qualify ZeroComa-to-EDICOM interconnection without a sender EDICOM connection; hold an unsupported or unknown path without replacing either selection. Prove address-ownership constraints and saved configuration remain respected. OUT-A23/25; SND-G02/09.
Independent action outcomes

Show recipient delivery complete while the required SPFE action is unresolved, and the reverse. Identify purpose, reason and next owner. Do not show full completion or repeat a completed action. Qualify any new response or event fields. Preserve currentStatus and history[] meanings. INT-SND02; SND-G04/05; OUT-A07, OUT-A19 and OUT-A24.
Contract issues / INT-SND02

Validate the schema inconsistency, missing definitions and guide/schema conflicts in SPEC-SEI-043 against the preserved sources. Corrected contracts must preserve existing France clients or use an approved compatibility path.
Formats and transformation / OUT-A06/11

Qualify Spain mappings, public UBL 2.5/rectification, private file combinations and optional Factur-X independently. Record DTS build, pack/version and semantic-loss results; FR/Demo rules do not become Spain defaults. SPFE-S08; INT-SND01; SND-G03/07.
Public delivery and copy / OUT-A03–05; OUT-SPFE-A01–04; OUT-A19/21

Exercise all four platform combinations in §2.2, with same-provider and different-provider private delivery. Prove the selected private platform sends and reports the copy; test result/error reporting and failed-copy retry ownership. Prove each handoff, hold unsupported/unknown paths, preserve completed actions and prevent an extra copy after public use. Exercise permitted withdrawal, fiscal correction, partial admission and qualified outages. Test delivery success with copy failure, then copy success with delivery failure. Pin the schema and credential port. Distinguish transport, request, item and CSV evidence. SPFE-S02/S03/S08/S16/S06; SND-G02/05/06.
Country isolation and compatibility / OUT-A11/12/17

Regress existing France behaviour. A Spain rule/route upgrade cannot change another country or an earlier action plan. Record API/build support, recovery owner, retention and measured operating limits. REF-PRODUCT; SND-G07.
Transitional PDF delivery / OUT-PDF-A01–03

Use a product-generated PDF in a qualified private manifest and upload it through the returned URL; prove actual recipient evidence. For the public structured route, use the qualified separate PDF channel. Inspect all public request parts for exclusion. Failed PDF work must not repeat successful invoice/copy actions. Regress FR file choices and one-client accountant sending. RD238-T2; INT-SND01; SND-G08.
